title: Decide what the Alpaca mirror is FOR, then make its invariant say that
note:
RE-SCOPED 2026-09-21, same day it was written. The first version said 'extend the Bybit roster-sync test to alpaca_live / alpaca_portfolio' on the premise that NO invariant existed. THAT PREMISE WAS FALSE and was inferred rather than checked (a RULE ONE failure). tests/test_paper_portfolio_accounts.py::test_alpaca_portfolio_mirrors_alpaca_live_minus_proxies DOES exist and asserts set(live legs minus affordability proxies) <= set(portfolio legs), in every state. What is true and still a problem: that is a SUBSET assertion, deliberately, so it protects real money (no live leg without a paper counterpart) and does NOT make the mirror representative. Measured 2026-09-21: live 5 legs, mirror 14 -- nine mirror legs are not on the live book -- so Gate 2's demotion signal cannot be read off the mirror's aggregate. The test's own comment argues that asserting equality during a staged go-live would force alpaca_portfolio from 14 legs to 1 and destroy the paper research book. That argument is good and must be ANSWERED, not overwritten. [!] OPERATOR DECIDED 2026-09-21: STRICT EQUALITY, LIKE BYBIT. alpaca_portfolio carries exactly alpaca_live's roster, enforced by a test mirroring test_bybit_portfolio_mirrors_bybit_2_exactly. Chosen over keeping the subset with a per-leg demotion read, and over dropping Alpaca from Gate 2 entirely. [!] THE COST WAS STATED WHEN ASKED AND IS ACCEPTED: the 9 surplus mirror legs stop accruing shadow ML data. Do not re-litigate that as a discovery. [!] WHAT THIS BUYS: Gate 2's demotion signal becomes readable off the Alpaca mirror's aggregate, which today it is not — live 5 legs vs mirror 14 means the aggregate cannot mean what the ladder says it means. [!] DISPATCHED 2026-09-21 on OPUS: it edits config on accounts that trade, and although the mirror is paper, the roster it must match is alpaca_live's, which is real money. [!] LANE TOLD IT HAS NO OPERATOR OK FOR A TIER-2/3 CONFIG CHANGE. If the roster edit lands in those tiers it lands the Tier-1 half, states the exact one-line change, and STOPS — and it was told explicitly that leaving the new test RED against current config is a legitimate outcome that makes the gap loud, while weakening the test to go green is not. [!] AND TOLD NOT TO TOUCH alpaca_live: if the two differ, alpaca_live is the truth and the MIRROR moves. [!] POINTED at the `minus_proxies` carve-out in the existing test name, to establish whether it encodes real instruments that cannot mirror rather than deleting it silently — and at CLAUDE.md's record that an earlier session INFERRED 'no invariant exists' here and was wrong, so this is replacing a considered design with another, not fixing an oversight. [!] OPERATOR APPROVED 2026-09-21 (popup): cut alpaca_portfolio to exactly [ief_pullback_1d, slv_pullback_1d]. THE NUMBER MOVED AND THEY WERE TOLD -- the surplus is 12, not the 9 this row, the plan and CLAUDE.md all say, because A6 (#12673) pulled tlt_pullback_1d/tlt_pullback_1h off alpaca_live the same day. All 12 keep trading on alpaca_paper; what is lost is their record at the portfolio risk basis. [!] AND THE EMPTY-alpaca_live QUESTION THE LANE RAISED IS DECIDED: EQUALITY WINS -- an empty live book means an empty mirror, no exception. The lane had built a fail-and-ask (equality AND non-empty); that assertion comes out. The accepted cost is explicit and stays on the record in the test: when Gate 2 demotes the last live leg, the Alpaca demotion signal disappears with the mirror and nothing flags the gap. [!] ⚠️ TWO LANES HAVE NOW DIED ON THIS WITHOUT COMMITTING ANYTHING. The first spent $229.13 against a $30 ceiling and ended on 'git commit denied by permission rule' with four edits staged in a container that is now gone. The re-dispatch spent ~$0 and stalled at the same wall, and its pending action was readable: `git fetch origin main 2>&1 | tail -5 && git merge origin/main --no-edit 2>&1 | tail -60` -- a COMPOUND, PIPED git command awaiting an interactive Bash approval in an unattended session. [!] THE WORK ITSELF IS FOUR EDITS AND A PUSH, fully specified and operator-approved; nothing about the task is hard. Attempt 3 is dispatched with a firm $20 ceiling, simple single-purpose git commands, and an instruction to STOP after two refusals and report which command. See E20. [!] APPLIED 2026-09-22 BY THE MANAGER, under manager-scope exception MGR-20260921-B2-ROSTER-EDIT, after a THIRD lane failed the same way. alpaca_portfolio cut 14 -> [ief_pullback_1d, slv_pullback_1d]; the non-empty-mirror assertion removed with its ARGUMENT KEPT in the test's docstring as an operator-decided accepted cost; CLAUDE.md's 'the roster does not yet' corrected. tests/test_paper_portfolio_accounts.py: 6 passed, 1 skipped -- the deliberate red resolved by the decision, not by weakening the test. [!] ⚠️ THE THIRD LANE REFUTED THE MANAGER'S OWN PUBLISHED HYPOTHESIS: it was dispatched with compound/piped git commands explicitly forbidden and stalled anyway, on a plain `python3 -m pytest ... -q`. The guess is withdrawn where it was made (PI-20260921-LANE-BLOCKED-ON-AN-UNATTENDED-PERMISSION-PROMPT), not quietly dropped. [!] THE EXCEPTION COVERS WHO TYPED IT, NOT WHAT WAS TYPED -- the content was operator-approved before any of this. [!] STATE CORRECTED AT CLOSE-OUT: this row read `in_flight` against a lane that is ARCHIVED and work that is MERGED (#12687, 025de03). A stale `in_flight` tells the next session a lane is live when it is not, and it will route around work that is actually free. [!] `landed_unproven`, NOT `done`, and the observation that closes it is specific: `alpaca_portfolio.strategies` read off `/api/bot/config` ON THE RUNNING TRADER showing exactly [ief_pullback_1d, slv_pullback_1d]. The tree says so; the running process has not been asked. Same caveat A6 carries, for the same reason. [!] CLOSING OBSERVATION, ADDED BY THE MANAGER 2026-09-22 at close-out, because this was the one landed_unproven row of 14 that did not name one -- and a landed_unproven row without a named observation is indistinguishable from a row nobody intends to close. CLOSING THIS ROW MEANS reading /api/bot/config on the RUNNING process and seeing alpaca_portfolio at exactly [ief_pullback_1d, slv_pullback_1d]. [!] PARTIAL AS OF 2026-09-22T09:05:45Z: that read already returns those 2 legs, AND tests/test_alpaca_portfolio_mirrors_alpaca_live_exactly_minus_proxies passes. But it is NOT yet `done`, for the same reason R2 is not: the field carrying the account mode in that payload is literally named `yaml_mode`, so /api/bot/config reports what the FILE on the VM says, not what the trader has loaded. The trader reloading its roster is a separate fact from the file being updated, and nothing read this session establishes it. Whatever closes R2 closes this.
